source_text: FGC, however, yields no documented benefits and is linked to immediate complications such as hemorrhage (up to 15% in some settings), infection, and shock, alongside long-term sequelae including urinary retention, keloid scarring, dyspareunia, and increased maternal mortality from obstructed labor (up to 55% higher risk in severe cases). [95] [96]
